body:
## Pull request overview

This PR improves `@object-ui/plugin-calendar` calendar rendering performance and correctness by reducing per-cell event filtering overhead, stabilizing default date handling, improving HEX color readability, and forwarding missing props from `ObjectCalendar` to `CalendarView`.

**Changes:**
- Add Map-based event indexing in `MonthView` to avoid O(42N) filtering per render.
- Improve event styling for HEX colors (ensure readable text) across month/week/day views.
- Forward `locale` and `onEventDrop` from `ObjectCalendar` to `CalendarView`, and add a new test suite for these behaviors.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugin-calendar/src/CalendarView.tsx | Adds Map-based event index, memoization, HEX color class handling, and introduces a stable default date constant. |
| packages/plugin-calendar/src/ObjectCalendar.tsx | Extends props with `onEventDrop` and `locale`, forwarding both to `CalendarView` (including `event.data` unwrapping). |
| packages/plugin-calendar/src/__tests__/calendar-optimizations.test.tsx | Adds tests covering the event index behavior, HEX color styling, stable default date, and drag enablement. |

`STABLE_DEFAULT_DATE` is created at module load time, so rendering `<CalendarView />` without `currentDate` will use a potentially stale date (e.g., if the bundle is preloaded or the app stays open past midnight). This avoids the effect loop, but changes semantics from “default to now at mount” to “default to when the module was first evaluated”. Prefer a per-component stable default (e.g., `useRef(new Date())` / lazy state init) and only sync `selectedDate` from `currentDate` when the prop is actually provided/changes.

This assertion is likely brittle: when setting `style.backgroundColor = '#3b82f6'`, the DOM/JSDOM serializer typically normalizes it to an `rgb(...)` string. Consider asserting via `toHaveStyle('background-color: #3b82f6')` (jest-dom normalizes) or just assert that `backgroundColor` is set/non-empty instead of expecting the raw hex string.
```suggestion
      expect(eventEl).toHaveStyle('background-color: #3b82f6');
```
